source.title: Lichess official broadcasts, January 2020
source.attribution: Lichess and the original broadcast contributors; individual broadcast/game URLs retained in each record
source.modifications: Canonical SAN/UCI and metadata normalization. Derived scores omit comments, clocks, evaluations, NAGs and alternate annotations; original raw export retained. Derived game data remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
source.coverage: Entire bounded January 2020 official broadcast export, not a representative master population, selected GM roster or complete career archive. Every input record receives an accepted, duplicate or quarantine disposition. Acquisition checksum checked against the provider's broadcast sha256sums.txt on 2026-10-02.

limitations: Entire bounded January 2020 official broadcast export, not a representative master population, selected GM roster or complete career archive. Every input record receives an accepted, duplicate or quarantine disposition. Acquisition checksum checked against the provider's broadcast sha256sums.txt on 2026-10-02.
Names and legally replayed scores are not reviewed teaching, engine analysis or winning promises.
Source metadata is reported, not independently verified. Unresolved names remain source-scoped; no guessed GM aliases.
Raw annotations/evaluations are retained in source files only, not surfaced as move authority.
A recorded result and legal complete score do not prove the source did not omit earlier/later moves.
Data-only pack: the consumer must supply atomic installation, durable storage and reviewed teaching.
